Client-ID und API-Key erhältst du kosten: Get your Client-ID and API key for free at developers.deutschebahn.com (create an application -> subscribe to the Timetables API with the Free plan).
Free-Plan erlaubt 60 Aufrufe/Minute. Pro: The free plan allows 60 requests/minute. Each station uses about 2-3 requests per interval.
Tipp: Stationsnamen in \"Suchbegriff\" e: Tip: enter the station name in "Search term", then pick the matching station from the suggestions in the "EVA number" field next to it. Requirement: the instance must already be running with a valid Client-Id/Api-Key. Alternatively, the EVA number can also be entered directly.
